summary.en: If you are in National Health Insurance or the National Pension, a procedure separate from the move-out notice is needed when you move abroad. Ask the insurance and pension section of your ward office. The overseas move-out notice is needed if you will stay abroad for about one year or more; the guide is from 2 weeks before you move until the moving day (to be checked). Pension: once you live abroad you are no longer compulsorily covered by the National Pension. Japanese nationals can join voluntarily; apply at your city office before you leave. Non-Japanese nationals can claim a lump-sum withdrawal payment within 2 years after leaving Japan. Conditions apply, such as 6 months or more of paid contributions (to be checked). If you return and register your address, you must enroll again at the city office where you register.
